description.zh: 消费组的名称，不超过128个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称，便于后续识别。
description.en: The name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Specify a business-meaningful name for easy identification.

description.zh:
消费组的账号密码。

- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
- 密码长度为8~32个字符。
description.en:
The password of the consumer group account.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

description.zh:
消费组的账号。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线中的任意一种或多种组成。
最长 16 个字符。
description.en:
The username of the consumer group account.

The username can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The username can be up to 16 characters in length.

description.zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

description.zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

description.zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region in which the DTS change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.en: Create a consumer group for a change tracking task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts create-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsboss6pn1w000000 --dts-job-id boss6pn1w000000 --consumer-group-name '订阅组A' --consumer-group-password Test123456 --consumer-group-user-name dtstest --resource-group-id rg-aek2zx4uizich7y --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
